name: Nintendo 64
_notes: Default is the n64-c-buttons-on-right-stick preset: C buttons on right-stick half-axes, Z on l2 (the N64 Z trigger sits under the left hand on the centre grip), L on l1, R on r1. That leaves face_east and face_north unbound; the n64-c-buttons-on-face preset puts c_down on face_east and c_left on face_north (Mupen64Plus-Next style). rumble=true assumes a Rumble Pak; the actual pak is the 'pak' option (rumble|memory|transfer|none), not a controller type.
